hop-by-hop key relay through a trusted KMS; strongSwan endpoints and classical path created by CORE
DOCKER COMPOSE PLANE · QKD / KMS infrastructure · project qkdnetsim-key-relay-vpn · 7 ns-3 processes
CORE PLANE · classical network and VPN endpoints, created by vpn-topology.py
local Unix socket · PPK mode only
local Unix socket · PPK mode only
ESP transport mode · aes256-sha256 · configurable IKE SA renewal (REKEY_INTERVAL_S)
classical Alice–Bob path · CORE links and optional routers
one 10.253.i.0/30 per link · R = 0…8 routers (direct veth when R = 0)
TCP/9090 Alice–Bob key coordination: PSK mode only (no such channel in PPK mode)
